data.name: Whisker Works
data.detailed_description:
GET YOUR PAWS DIRTY!

Whisker Works is a physics-based renovation game for 1-4 players. Clean up trash, repair what's broken, haul out old furniture and turn ruined places into something worth looking at again.

CLEAN. BREAK. FIX.

Scrub dirt, collect garbage, clear overgrown areas, repair broken systems and give anything beyond saving one final meeting with the sledgehammer. Sometimes fixing things starts with breaking them a little more.

BRING THE CREW!

Work alone or team up with up to four players. Split the jobs, carry heavy objects together or make everything unnecessarily difficult for each other. Everyone has their own definition of teamwork.

DON'T TRUST PHYSICS

Carry, throw, drop and interact with objects through physics-based gameplay. A perfectly normal cleaning job can become an uncontrolled cat operation in a matter of seconds.

MAKE IT PURRFECT!

Sometimes the job gets done through flawless teamwork. Sometimes everything goes completely off the rails. What matters is leaving the place better than you found it.

We clean, we fix, we PURRFECT!

IMPORTANT!!!Whisker Works is currently in development. Screenshots shown are from a work-in-progress build and visuals may change.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 10100TE (Q2 2020), Intel Core i5 7400 (Q1 2017), AMD Ryzen™ 3 1300X (Q3 2017) AMD Ryzen™ 5 PRO 2500U (Q1 2019), Intel Core i7 8650U (Q3 2017),
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Mobile 6GB, AMD Radeon RX 5600M 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600K, AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 4060 Ti 8GB, Radeon RX 6700 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
